crossRefs.note: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching:
for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.
Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;
for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.
Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.
My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.
A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.
Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.

people.name: Jonadab
people.line: Son of Rechab, who promoted Rechabite lifestyle

people.name: Rechab
people.line: Ancestor of the Rechabites, who were faithful to God

translations.web: We have obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, in all that he commanded us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, or our daughters;
translations.bsb: And we have obeyed the voice of our forefather Jonadab son of Rechab in all he commanded us. So we have not drunk wine all our lives—neither we nor our wives nor our sons and daughters.
translations.kjv: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he hath charged us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, nor our daughters;
translations.asv: And we have obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, in all that he charged us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, or our daughters;
